notes.title: Big update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We are introducing new game regime Sandbox. Check it out!
Train your skills and complete tasks to unlock new levels and upgrade your weapons. And be always ready for a music bonus level.

Weapons upgrade.
Every weapon has three levels to upgrade. Every new level will add more score points to every hit. Level up and rule the leaderboard. 

And try out our new feature: crossbow darts now explodes the bombs.

notes.title: We have launched! Time to take up arms!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that we are now available on Steam Early Access. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34898626/a1d7fddd7aa5245805c59055fea54431214b7ce6.jpg
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1041690/Mace_and_Grace/
Time to take up arms against the uber narcissistically spoiled and somewhat insane Prince Charmin and his bottom-less  'Knights of Amor'. 

Stay tuned for updates on new weapons, ideas and contests as they charge your way. 


During our Early Access program, we really would love as many people to join us in our discord and help us make the most kick-ass Medieval Arcade game ever! We are looking for your ideas. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34898626/4a3279e4fcab7fe6e0aee6d86dcc59bd8e4507a5.png

We want to thank you again for your support.

notes.title: Smashing into Early Access - May 15th!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34898626/b25ce9825c20a5af9c473440e0cb52789715d021.png

We are happy to announce that our furiously furious medieval VR game will be hitting the digital streets this next week, May 15th!

Get ready to start the brutality by smashing oncoming enemy knights to send them flying in spectacular fashion. 

Gameplay Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0c-GQtFPyfQ

 Smack the heck out of the oncoming boxer clad enemy knights who are coming to steal your lady for the egotistical  neighboring prince. 

It won’t all be for the sake of clobbering, however, as you get to have a blast dodging oncoming bombs. 💥

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34898626/bfab533d198ab243c4761ad877341a2a9008d2cb.png

 Three game modes: Rage, Survival, Gore
 Fight off enemy knights with a variety of weapons at launch including maces, spears, axes, clubs, crossbows, bare hands, and fire breath
 Send knights flying with the hardest hits possible to earn more points
 Smash two knights in one blow to activate rage mode
 Dodge oncoming bombs with evasive maneuvering
 Take advantage of slo-mo bonuses
 Challenge friends and compete for bragging rights on the global leaderboard

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34898626/7390f81ceea25ba593604b95f60cbee3b6e9ebc9.jpg

Price: $9.99 (Offering a 20% discount during the game’s launch week.)

VR Headset Support:  
 HTC Vive 
 Oculus Rift
Windows Mixed Reality VR 

No Blood Option: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oFPWUmykKuI&feature=em-share_video_user
LIV Support:  Yes! We LIV it and You LIV it! 😎

Don't forget to join our Discord, as Community is super important to us as we continue into Early Access as a huge part of Early Access is YOU and your ideas and feedback! 😁
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34898626/4a3279e4fcab7fe6e0aee6d86dcc59bd8e4507a5.png

and of course wishlist today! If you haven't already 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1041690/Mace_and_Grace/
